source: Hand rows over the K3 catalog (catalog_k3.py) for the machines of Onda 2, sublote 2, group 2b: what the K3 scan does not read (resistance) and each one's gap text. generate.py merges them by id.

entries.behavior_gap: A memorial in the 1.7.10 itself (MachineIGenerator): one cell, no screen (its openGui is commented out), an empty updateEntity and 21 slots no side reaches; ported: its ILookOverlay text (ntm-core look_overlay, drawn by the client HUD) and igen.obj at a sixth of its size. The 21 slots are not ported: nothing can put an item in them.
